About the Village Bike & Fitness Tuesday Night Road Ride group ride

A shop-led road ride on rolling roads toward Rockford and Cannonsburg and around downtown. It teaches group skills like calling hazards and riding a paceline. Helmets required, lights recommended.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
